egress.terms: Free and anonymous for reads; resolves to HF's own CDN. Not applicable as a storage delta. The bytes live on HF, which is already known and excluded as a discovery.

record.tooling: Drop-in hostname swap: HF_ENDPOINT=https://hf-mirror.com for huggingface_hub / hf_transfer / rclone (rclone 'hf' backend points at it).
record.chaining: Functions as an edge cache mirror for Hugging Face datasets. Provides an alternate delivery route for downloads, while terms exclude hotlinking and intentional exhaustion of shared bandwidth.
record.limits_note: per-object-cap: inherits HF (50 GB/file at the time of the linked HF issues). Retention: inherits HF. Write path is redirected straight to huggingface.co, not mirrored: probe POST /api/repos/create -> 308 Location: https://huggingface.co/api/repos/create. So the mirror gives you nothing new to store INTO.
record.reliability_note: Reads work; One probe returned a bare 200 with an HTML body from the LFS batch endpoint rather than JSON. Parse the body, not the status.
